canDoYue: 你識客氣咁話菜凍、未煮熟、等太耐，並接受換菜同免費甜品。
canDoEn: Say the dish is cold or undercooked, ask for a replacement, and accept a complimentary dessert.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Excuse me please, Ana. I ordered the soup, but the bowl arrived cold at our little table.
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思 Ana。我點咗湯，但係個碗送到我哋檯係凍嘅。
dialogue.say: Excuse me please, Ana. I ordered the soup, but the bowl arrived cold at our little table.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I understand the problem with the bowl, and I can bring some warm rice instead of that soup.
dialogue.glossYue: 我明白個問題，我可以改送熱飯，唔使再要嗰碗湯。
dialogue.say: I understand the problem with the bowl, and I can bring some warm rice instead of that soup.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: The side looks really undercooked after the long wait, and the meal came much too late.
dialogue.glossYue: 配菜好似未煮熟，等咗好耐，餐遲咗好多。
dialogue.say: The side looks really undercooked after the long wait, and the meal came much too late.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: The manager can kindly replace the whole dish with a fresh plate if that suits you well.
dialogue.glossYue: 經理可以換過成碟，如果你覺得啱。
dialogue.say: The manager can kindly replace the whole dish with a fresh plate if that suits you well.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Could you please bring a complimentary warm dessert for both of us after you fix that plate?
dialogue.glossYue: 換完之後，可唔可以畀我哋兩份免費甜品？
dialogue.say: Could you please bring a complimentary warm dessert for both of us after you fix that plate?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I will send a fresh plate right away, and I will tell the kitchen about it.
dialogue.glossYue: 我即刻送碟新鮮嘅出嚟，同時話廚房知。
dialogue.say: I will send a fresh plate right away, and I will tell the kitchen about it.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.text: Please do not let this happen again when we come back for a main course later on.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋下次再嚟點主菜，唔好再有呢件事。
dialogue.say: Please do not let this happen again when we come back for a main course later on.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: I appreciate your patience with us, and the kitchen will cook the fish properly this time round.
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝你耐心，廚房今次會將條魚煮得啱啱好。
dialogue.say: I appreciate your patience with us, and the kitchen will cook the fish properly this time round.
